sources.title: Plant Disease Diagnosis
limitations: General plant-disease diagnostic guidance; it is not cannabis-specific.
It supports a hypothesis-testing method and the need for converging evidence, not identification of a particular pest, pathogen, or deficiency from one symptom.

sources.title: Diagnosing Plant Disorders
limitations: General extension guidance for diagnosing plant disorders; it is not cannabis-specific.
Its examples are not evidence that the same cause applies to a cannabis plant, cultivar, medium, facility, or growth stage.

sources.title: Cannabis Yield, Potency, and Leaf Photosynthesis Respond Differently to Increasing Light Levels in an Indoor Environment
limitations: Controlled indoor flowering study with one cannabis cultivar and study-specific light treatments.
It provides light-response context but does not diagnose tip damage, prove light burn from appearance, or establish a universal threshold across cultivars and facilities.

sources.title: Elevated root-zone P and nutrient concentration do not increase yield or cannabinoids in medical cannabis
limitations: Controlled medical-cannabis study with its own cultivar, root-zone, nutrient, and facility conditions.

Its reported absence of leaf necrosis under the tested higher nutrient conditions limits overgeneralization; it does not rule out salt or nutrient injury under other conditions and does not diagnose a plant from tip appearance.

sources.title: Foliar Symptomology, Nutrient Content, Yield, and Secondary Metabolite Variability of Cannabis Grown Hydroponically with Different Single-Element Nutrient Deficiencies
limitations: Controlled hydroponic flowering study using one cultivar and induced single-element deficiencies.
Observed symptom patterns do not establish that appearance alone identifies a deficiency in other cultivars, media, facilities, stages, or multi-factor grow conditions.

sources.title: Hydroponics Systems and Principles Of Plant Nutrition: Essential Nutrients, Function, Deficiency, and Excess
limitations: General hydroponic plant-nutrition guidance with examples from non-cannabis crops.
It does not establish a cannabis diagnosis, a universal EC or pH target, or a flush prescription from symptom appearance.

sources.title: PR #627 route-cohort authorization and lineage
limitations: This record establishes only that the four routes were an approved post-v1 implementation cohort and records their repository lineage.
It is not scientific evidence, evidence review, cultivation review, editorial approval, publication verification, or rendered-crawl verification, and no claim may cite it as support.

sources.title: Excess Fertilizer or Salt Damage on Flowers
limitations: General extension guidance for ornamental flowers and garden soils; it is not cannabis-specific.
Marginal browning and scorch are nonspecific, and this source does not justify diagnosing salt injury or prescribing leaching for cannabis from appearance alone.
